messages.subject: Project Falcon - COMPLETED
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

I'm pleased to confirm that the Series B financing of Penrose Robotics completed today. £14m has been received, the Series B Preferred Shares have been allotted (1,000,000 shares at £14.00), and Marcus Pell is appointed as Investor Director with effect from completion. Share certificates are being issued and we will make the Companies House filings.

Congratulations to everyone. It's been a pleasure working with you all.

Sarah

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
